simulator.note: Boots as the M3329 family (chips/m3329.py): M3329.default_chip_id() selects 0x3329 (M3329E) from the 3329EA bootloader's early check and M3329._uses_spi_flash() leaves parallel NOR disconnected so the native SPI flash controller serves its 4 MB flash.  The bootloader prints "APP  init ok", unpacks the 3.94 MB LZMA maincode to SDRAM and starts it ("Starting mcas v.1.0 compiled Sep  4 2009").  M3329E's GE_M36 at 0xB800E000 (GeM3602(base=0xE000)), DECV_M3327 at 0xB8013200 on IC line 12, SND_M3327 ready bits at 0xB80020E3..E4, and OSD_S36 regions in the second 8 MB SDRAM segment (0x00800000) render the live-TV channel banner ("0001. 1PLUS1 UKR+RUS") while PAN_pt6312_0 drives the 8-character 14-segment PT6312 VFD on GPIO 3 (CLK) / 2 (DIO) / 4 (STB) through "  BOOT  " -> "   ON   " -> "--------" -> "1PLUS1  ".  Pressing OK and DOWN opens the channel list ("Список телеканалів") and moves selection to channel 0002 ("$Inter").

desc: 4 MB SPI flash dump (firmware 1.0.78, MultiCAS v.1.0, Sep 4 2009) from an Opticum 7300 PVR CI2CX DVB-S satellite PVR receiver.

Powered by ALi M3329E — the late M3327-platform bridge SoC that pairs the M3327 OSD/VPO display pipe with an M3602-generation command-list 2D graphics engine at 0xB800E000, MPEG-2 video engine at 0xB8013200, and an 8-character 14-segment PT6312 VFD front panel.
